definitions.selected_base_model: Immutable checkpoint identity (model_id + revision sha) of the unadapted base model chosen for official model-backed systems. Null until a model is formally selected and frozen.
definitions.selected_adapter: Identity of a trained adapter (e.g. LoRA) approved for official use with a base model. Null until an adapter is trained, evaluated, and formally selected.
definitions.selected_model_strategy: Identifier of the frozen inference/decoding strategy (prompting, sampling, routing configuration) approved for official runs of model-backed or structured-analysis-dependent systems. Null until frozen.
definitions.status: Lifecycle marker for this contract: 'no_selection' means every identity field is null and no official model-backed run may proceed.
definitions.valid_for_official_use: True only once every required identity field for the systems being run is populated and formally frozen; always false while status is 'no_selection'.

legacy_selected_model_field.note: The licence register's top-level 'selected_model' field predates this contract and must remain null. This file (selected_identities_v1.json) is the single source of truth for model/adapter/strategy identity going forward.
